doc: Sweeps the 4-slot D_80083110[] pointer array; for each non-NULL slot, calls func_800488F0(slot->unk08, slot->unk28, 1) then clears the slot to NULL.

globals.name: D_80083110
globals.decl: extern S_80083110 *D_80083110[4]; /* array of 4 pointers to S_80083110-typed objects (struct with fields at offset 0x08 = s32 unk08 and 0x28 = s32 unk28); indexed 0..3 by both func_80048998 (writer, index = a1-1) and func_80048B28 (sweeper, index 0..3)

calls: func_800488F0(s32 a0, s32 a1, s32 a2) : notification/cleanup callback; called with (cur->unk08, cur->unk28, reason) where reason=1 for the timeout-sweep path in func_80048B28 (siblings pass 2 or 3 for other paths)
